what: Phase 1 complete: unify context pack into explore tool
why: Implemented and verified the first phase of the graph-exploration improvement plan

author: Mario Sandoval (Sv Tech)

next_steps: Present Phase 1 commit message for user confirmation, then begin Phase 2: rewrite protocol.go Graph Inspection block to position graph as grep/read substitute
